metadata.question: Was there more sediment in the Mekong River, specifically at location (20.248364, 100.141422), in January 27, 2015 compared to January 25, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare sediment levels in the Mekong River at a specific location between two dates: January 27, 2015 vs January 25, 2020. For sediment analysis, I need to: 1. Use satellite imagery that can detect sediment/turbidity in water 2. Common approaches: - Use Landsat 8 (available for both dates) or Sentinel-2 - Calculate turbidity/sediment indices like: * NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) - to identify water pixels * Turbidity indices using red/NIR bands * Simple approach: Use SWIR or red band reflectance (higher = more sediment) Strategy: - Use Landsat 8 Surface Reflectance for consistency across both dates - Define a small buffer around the point to analyze river pixels - Mask clouds and cloud shadows - Calculate mean reflectance in water-sensitive bands for sediment proxy - Compare the values between the two dates Data quality checks: - Check if images exist for both dates - Check if valid water pixels remain after masking - Validate the calculated values are reasonable ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([100.141422, 20.248364]); const buffer = point.buffer(500); // 500m buffer around the point const date2015 = '2015-01-27'; const date2020 = '2020-01-25'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 8 Surface Reflectance const getL8Collection = function(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); }; const col2015 = getL8Collection(date2015, ee.Date(date2015).advance(1, 'day')); const col2020 = getL8Collection(date2020, ee.Date(date2020).advance(1, 'day')); const size2015 = col2015.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Images: ${size2015}, 2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2015 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the best image (least cloud cover) for each date const img2015 = col2015.sort('CLOUD_COVER').first(); const img2020 = col2020.sort('CLOUD_COVER').first(); // 3. Processing - Cloud masking and sediment analysis // Use SWIR1 band (band 6) as proxy for sediment (higher reflectance = more sediment) // Also calculate NDWI to identify water pixels const addNDWI = function(image) { const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDWI'); // Green - NIR return image.addBands(ndwi); }; const img2015_processed = addNDWI(img2015); const img2020_processed = addNDWI(img2020); // Mask to water pixels (NDWI > 0) and get SWIR1 reflectance const getSedimentValue = function(image) { const waterMask = image.select('NDWI').gt(0.1); // Water pixels const sedimentBand = image.select('SR_B6').updateMask(waterMask); // SWIR1 band const stats = sedimentBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: buffer, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats; }; const stats2015 = getSedimentValue(img2015_processed).getInfo(); const stats2020 = getSedimentValue(img2020_processed).getInfo(); console.log(`2015 SWIR1: ${stats2015?.mean?.toFixed(4)} (px: ${stats2015?.count})`); console.log(`2020 SWIR1: ${stats2020?.mean?.toFixed(4)} (px: ${stats2020?.count})`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (!stats2015 || !stats2020 || stats2015.count === 0 || stats2020.count === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (stats2015.mean === null || stats2020.mean === null || isNaN(stats2015.mean) || isNaN(stats2020.mean)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare sediment levels (higher SWIR1 reflectance = more sediment) const sediment2015 = stats2015.mean; const sediment2020 = stats2020.mean; console.log(`Sediment 2015: ${sediment2015.toFixed(4)}, 2020: ${sediment2020.toFixed(4)}`); if (sediment2015 > sediment2020) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
